reader.requirement: At --std 85, each relative file's FD must associate its file-name with its own file connector: one FD per SELECTed file, followed by one or more record descriptions that share its record area, each connector's open state and position independent of every other file-name's, including a file-name in another program.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 an FD with no record description entry is refused (COBOL1837, §1985:VIII.3.2.3 SR3); 2002+ builds the implied record
passes the program's --std to the connector (FileConnector.Edition), read by the sharing and CLOSE WITH LOCK DialectBehaviors; the connector itself is the same

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel over FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs, KeyedIoEmitter.cs#EmitRegistration, FileRegistry.cs#RegisterRelative.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a record-less FD is refused (2023 compiles it with an implied record); the association of file-name to connector is the same code
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness has two relative FDs with separate connectors; it does not exercise the FD/SELECT correspondence refusals, two record descriptions of one FD, a same-named file in another program, or statements after a failed OPEN

reader.notes: BindFileSection attaches each FD to its SELECT's FileModel, and emission registers one connector per file key (per program). Connectors stay independent across programs and after failed statements.
